With 84 billion CHF assets under management and a Swiss-wide presence, we have the expertise, network and experience to successfully execute complex transactions and strengthen our customers’ position in the market. For our still young, growing Transaction Advisory Team we are looking for an interested and open personality as Junior Manager Transaction Advisory (m/f/d) Opfikon, 80-100% This is what you do:
• You are actively involved in real estate transactions and accompany the entire process: from the initial market and object analysis to the preparation of relevant documents to operational support in closing. • You keep an eye on market trends: by preparing research results, you support your team in establishing and maintaining a network of brokers, owners and other market participants
• You contribute to the development of target group-oriented marketing strategies and create high-quality presentations, exposés and investment analyses
• Internal and external stakeholders manage effortlessly. You prepare meetings and make sure that all relevant information is structured and on time. This is why you succeed:
• You have completed a degree in real estate management, business administration, economics or a similar discipline

• Education and training: Promoting employees is an important part of our culture. Benefit from generous support in internal and external education and training. We offer career opportunities in management, specialist and project functions
